title: Well-formedness of a queried-coordinate tree
statement: Let $C$ be a list of distinct coordinates, each belonging to a finite set $A$, let $s\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $F$ assign a coordinate decision tree to each Boolean-cube vector. If every tree $F(x)$ is well formed with respect to the coordinates in $A$ outside $C$, then the tree formed by querying the coordinates in $C$ from seed $s$, with both bit branches at each query, is well formed with respect to $A$.
hypotheses_covered: Every coordinate in C belongs to A
F maps Boolean-cube inputs to coordinate decision trees
For every x, F(x) is well formed with respect to A minus the coordinates in C
